central_node: Planetary Rotations, Annual Seasonal Dynamics, and Agricultural Bio-Indicators

key_details: Earth rotates on its axis from west to east every 24 hours
Sunlit side experiences daytime; shadowed opposite side experiences night
Apparent solar motion from east to west is caused by Earth's rotation
Shadows are long at morning and late evening (low Sun angle)
Shadows are shortest at solar noon (Sun high overhead)
Shadow angles shift continuously as Earth rotates
Documents annual shifts across 5 core themes:
3. Air, Heat & Light, 4. Water Bodies, 5. Human Lifestyle
Biological organisms respond to seasonal weather changes
Singing of the Koel (cuckoo) bird in Odisha announces coming monsoons
Acts as a traditional signal for farmers to sow crop seeds
real_world_examples: Koel bird song timing seed sowing in Odisha
